Really sorry for the confusion. I can replicate what you described: some attendees see a Meet link in the calendar entry, others see Zoom. My first guess is that an organizer alias / delegate change caused GCal to substitute a Meet link for certain domains (we've seen this with some GSuite setups).

Quick plan:

Neha / Elliot —

Confirmed: the event was originally created by a forwarding rule on a shared alias (demo@redwood.com) and then later updated manually by Marissa from her delegated calendar. GCal will sometimes rewrite the visible join button to Meet when the organizer is a delegated alias without an explicit conferencing payload in the organizer's account.

What I recommend (fastest, lowest risk):
1) Generate a fresh Zoom single-use join URL (I can do this).
2) Create a new calendar update from Neha's primary mailbox (neha_kapoor@redwood.com) with the Zoom link inserted in the body and conferencing field, attach regenerated_event.ics.
3) Send the update as a required-attendee-only change (so rooms/secondary calendars don't auto-accept a rewritten payload).

I will hold the new Zoom link and the ICS here and wait for your go-ahead, Neha. If you prefer, we can instead claim the original event under Marissa and attempt an organizer transfer, but that often takes extra time and may not propagate to all attendees before Tuesday.

-ben
